question: For each ice/mixed row on the Oregon volcano, Hood and Wallowa mountains, keep ice or change to alpine/mountaineering?
answer: None of the 32 rows is an ice-climbing crag route. Mountain Project files them as Ice/Snow/Alpine, and their AI/WI grades describe a steep-snow or rime-ice pitch on a volcano. Under the owner rule (technical snow-ice or mixed on a peak is alpine), 31 should be alpine. Only the South Side Route (AI1, Easy Snow, the standard walk-up) is non-technical: mountaineering.
recommendation: Change 31 rows to alpine and South Side Route to mountaineering (and make each row's disciplines list include its primary). If the owner wants one true-ice row kept, Full Richardson (WI4+ pitch) is the only candidate. KIDS (North Sister) and Exegesis (Ice Lake Peaks) had no page found: apply the same rule but treat their existence and grade as unconfirmed.

proposed.name: Full Richardson
proposed.why: North-face couloir, 1,000 ft: WI2/3 steps, a 30 m WI4+ crux, then snow and an M3 exit, rappel descent. The most ice-like row, but still a mountain route; alpine. Owner call if one true ice row is wanted.

proposed.name: High Noon
proposed.why: 700 ft south-face line: 40-50 degree snow then rime ice and loose mixed ground, Easy 5th AI3; any 5.x on a peak is alpine.

proposed.name: Black Spider - Fric-Amos
proposed.why: Three pitches on a 1,000 ft face of rotten rock plus ephemeral ice flows, WI4 M4+ PG13: a mixed alpine face with overhead hazard, not a stable ice crag.

proposed.name: Black Spider - Three Little Monkeys (Burkhardt-Getlin)
proposed.why: Same Black Spider face, WI4+ M5- steep snow, X rating; roped mixed alpine climb.

proposed.name: Wy'East
proposed.why: Listed ice/snow/alpine, Easy 5th with AI1-2 on moderate snow; any 5.x on a peak is alpine and the ice is a minor part.

proposed.name: East Face aka "Brainless Child" (Tyler Adams Memorial Route)
proposed.why: Listed 5.9 WI5+ steep snow, the hardest unrepeated alpine route in Oregon per the area page; roped rock plus ice on a peak is alpine.

proposed.name: Western Gulch
proposed.why: AI2-3 steep snow gulch on Thielsen; technical snow-ice on a peak.

proposed.name: Exegesis
proposed.why: AI2 M2-3 steep snow, but no page for it was found for the Wallowas (a granite crag area); unverified. If real it is a roped snow/mixed climb, so alpine.

proposed.name: Devil's Kitchen Headwall (DKH) - Left Variation
proposed.why: Four pitches of steep snow and ice steps (AI2-3, PG13) protected with screws and pickets: technical snow-ice on a volcano, not a waterfall-ice crag.

proposed.name: Devil's Kitchen Headwall (DKH) - Right Variation
proposed.why: Two-pitch ice and snow variation on the crater wall (AI2-3); a roped snow-ice climb on a peak.

proposed.name: East Crater Wall (DKH V4)
proposed.why: Crater-wall variation, AI2 steep snow, two pitches; technical snow-ice on a peak.

proposed.name: Flying Buttress (DKH V3)
proposed.why: Crater-wall variation, AI2 moderate snow, two pitches; technical snow-ice on a peak.

proposed.name: Icefall Chute (Boy Scouts Chute)
proposed.why: Two-pitch rime and ice chute (AI2, PG13) on the crater wall; a mountain route, not an ice crag.

proposed.name: Men of Steel
proposed.why: Three pitches (800 ft) up gullies on Steel Cliff, AI3 PG13, wants thick rime ice, screws and pickets; alpine snow-ice on a peak.

proposed.name: South Side Route
proposed.why: Classic walk-up on Hood: Easy Snow, ice rating only AI1. An axe-and-crampon snow climb with no roped technical terrain, so mountaineering fits the owner rule (non-technical walk-up).

proposed.name: Steel Cliff South Face
proposed.why: Rimed gully route on Steel Cliff, AI2 steep snow; technical snow-ice on a peak.

proposed.name: North Face Couloir
proposed.why: WI2-3 couloir; a forum commenter says it needs two tools and probably a rope and gear for two near-vertical icy steps. Technical snow-ice on a peak.

proposed.name: North Face of the Northwest Ridge
proposed.why: WI2+ moderate snow, two tools wanted even to solo; steep snow-ice on a peak. Borderline mountaineering if only steep snow, but ice tools are needed.

proposed.name: Silver Couloir
proposed.why: WI2 moderate snow, described in a 2020 trip report as straightforward steep snow; needs axe and tools but little ice. Alpine, though mountaineering is defensible if the owner counts steep-snow routes as walk-ups.

proposed.name: Cathedral Ramp
proposed.why: Four pitches of mixed, ice and snow (WI3 M3) near Eliot Glacier; roped mixed on a peak is alpine.

proposed.name: Eliot Glacier Headwall
proposed.why: Five pitches, glacier approach, 4th class plus AI2-3 steep snow; a glacier headwall route, alpine.

proposed.name: North Face Left Gully
proposed.why: Steep snow and ice gully on the north face (WI3-4); technical, alpine not an ice crag.

proposed.name: North Face Right Gully
proposed.why: Three pitches, WI3 moderate snow, listed trad/ice/snow/alpine; a volcano face route, alpine.

proposed.name: Ravine
proposed.why: Two pitches, WI3 M4, listed trad/mixed/ice/snow/alpine; roped mixed on a peak.

proposed.name: East Buttress
proposed.why: A long rock-and-ice buttress listed WI3-4 M3-4; mixed ground on a peak is alpine. Little published detail found (a 2020 trip report exists; fetch blocked).

proposed.name: KIDS
proposed.why: Listed AI4-5 on North Sister; no page found, so existence and grade unconfirmed, but any steep snow-ice or mixed route on a peak is alpine.

proposed.name: Thayer Glacier Headwall
proposed.why: 3,500 ft mixed/ice/alpine, WI1 M3 PG13, climbed with pickets, nuts, cams and screws, very poor rock near the top; alpine.

proposed.name: Cathedral Ridge
proposed.why: Grade shows 5.0 plus AI2-3 steep snow; a ridge route mixing rock and snow-ice, alpine.

proposed.name: Leuthold Couloir
proposed.why: AI1-2 moderate snow couloir, about 2,000 ft; a step up from the South Side that is couloir climbing with tools and rope, so alpine rather than a walk-up.

proposed.name: Reid Glacier Headwall
proposed.why: AI3 steep snow glacier headwall; technical snow-ice on a peak.

proposed.name: Sandy Glacier Headwall
proposed.why: AI2 moderate snow, trad/ice/snow/alpine glacier headwall; technical snow-ice on a peak.

proposed.name: Yocum Ridge
proposed.why: AI3 steep snow, R: a long alpine ridge with glacier and rime ice.

evidence: https://www.mountainproject.com/area/125594589/south-side - Hood South Side routes all Ice/Snow/Alpine; South Side Route AI1 Easy Snow
